## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run mkdocs build --strict` passes locally.
- [ ] Prose follows the writing rules in CLAUDE.md (short declarative
      sentences, one sentence per line, no em-dash asides, no filler).
- [ ] Changed recipes have a dated line in their change history.
- [ ] Examples contain no names or details unless the contributor asked to be named.
- [ ] New or changed skill briefs contain no internal paths, names,
      credentials or institute forms.
